summary: Camden National Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting that its board declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.42 per share, payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record October 15, 2026. Based on the September 28, 2026 close of $57.40, the annualized yield is 2.93%. No advisors, premiums, or structural mechanics are involved. This is a routine capital-return event, not a special situation; the risk-arb angle is limited to ordinary dividend-capture timing around the record date.
